title: Enhancing Fairness: a cross-platform toolkit for identifying and mitigating data bias (back end and revised evaluation)
description: Back end of the DEBIAS toolkit and the complete, reproducible evaluation behind the revised manuscript 'Enhancing Fairness: A Cross-Platform Application for Mitigating Bias in Data Ecosystems' (Array, ARRAY-D-26-05264): code, pinned environment, configurations, seeds, datasets with checksums, raw and summary outputs, and scripts that regenerate every table and figure. See README.md and REVISION_LOG.md.
